1.1_llms_txt.note: probable.markets/llms.txt returns 403 (blocked). docs.probable.markets/llms.txt exists and returns structured documentation index with 19 doc links across 5 categories (GitBook-hosted).

1.2_markdown_negotiation.note: docs.probable.markets returns Content-Type: text/markdown; charset=utf-8 when Accept: text/markdown is sent. Returns clean markdown content. Main site blocked (403).

1.3_structured_metadata.note: Main site blocked (403), cannot verify meta tags. Docs site content shows no meta description or JSON-LD in the page excerpts examined.

2.1_content_without_js.note: docs.probable.markets serves real text content accessible without JavaScript. Main site blocked by Cloudflare so no content available without JS/browser.

2.2_semantic_html.note: Docs pages use basic HTML (h1, figure, figcaption, ul/li, strong) but lack nav, main, article, header, footer semantic elements. Only 0-1 of the required 3+ semantic elements found.

2.3_readable_url_slugs.note: Docs URLs are clean and readable: /overview/how-it-works, /trade-on-probable/trading-basics, /markets/how-are-markets-created, etc.

2.4_sitemap_xml.note: docs.probable.markets/sitemap.xml exists with sitemap index pointing to sitemap-pages.xml containing 17 URLs. Main site sitemap returns 403.

2.5_proper_404s.note: probable.markets/this-does-not-exist-xyz123 returns 403 (not a proper 404). Cloudflare blocks everything uniformly.

3.1_dev_docs_exist.note: docs.probable.markets exists as a GitBook-hosted documentation site with 17 pages covering platform mechanics, trading, markets, and points.

3.2_docs_findable.note: Main site is entirely blocked (403), so docs are not discoverable from the main site. No link path from probable.markets to docs.probable.markets is accessible to agents.

3.3_programmatic_surface_documented.note: No API, SDK, smart contract, subgraph, GraphQL, or any programmatic access documentation found anywhere in the docs. All content is user-facing trading guides only.

3.4_standard_navigation.note: Docs pages show minimal navigation. Only one external link (Discord) found. No sidebar nav links, no header/footer nav rendered in agent-accessible content. GitBook may render nav via JS only.

4.1_ai_crawlers_allowed.note: robots.txt explicitly blocks ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot, Amazonbot, Bytespider, Google-Extended, meta-externalagent, Applebot-Extended. Content-Signal: ai-train=no. Main site returns 403 to all non-browser requests.

4.2_no_captcha.note: Main site returns 403 for all non-browser user agents, effectively acting as a blanket block (likely Cloudflare challenge/WAF). This is functionally equivalent to a CAPTCHA wall for agents.

4.3_bot_policy_or_agent_docs.note: No bot policy page, no agent documentation, no terms for automated access. robots.txt has Cloudflare content-signal framework but no dedicated policy page.

summary: Probable scores a D (6/15). The main site (probable.markets) is entirely blocked by Cloudflare, returning 403 to all non-browser requests. The docs subdomain (docs.probable.markets, GitBook-hosted) is more accessible, supporting llms.txt and markdown content negotiation. However, the docs contain only user-facing trading guides with no API/SDK documentation, minimal semantic HTML, and navigation that appears JS-rendered. The robots.txt explicitly blocks all major AI crawlers. There is no programmatic surface documented and no bot/agent policy.
